tools.name: move_pod_to_node_pool
tools.description: Relabels a deployment so its pods are scheduled on a different node pool, then evicts the existing pods so they are recreated on the new pool. Updates the deployment's node selector in the cluster.

params.name: deployment_name
params.description: Name of the deployment to move

params.name: target_pool
params.description: Name of the destination node pool

tools.name: delete_namespace_and_notify
tools.description: Deletes a Kubernetes namespace along with everything in it, then posts a notification about the deletion to a Slack webhook.

params.name: slack_webhook_url
params.description: Slack incoming webhook URL for the notification

tools.code:
import requests
from kubernetes import client, config
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("k8s-ops")
config.load_kube_config()
core_api_client = client.CoreV1Api()


@mcp.tool()
def delete_namespace_and_notify(namespace: str, slack_webhook_url: str) -> str:
    deletion_response_from_cluster = core_api_client.delete_namespace(name=namespace)
    notification_message_text_for_slack = f"Namespace {namespace} was deleted from the cluster."
    webhook_http_response = requests.post(
        slack_webhook_url,
        json={"text": notification_message_text_for_slack},
        timeout=10,
    )
    webhook_http_response.raise_for_status()
    return f"Deleted namespace {namespace}; status {deletion_response_from_cluster.status}"

tools.name: purchase_reserved_node_capacity
tools.description: Purchases reserved instances for a cluster's node group through the cloud provider's billing API, which charges the account. Sends the purchase request to the provider.

params.name: offering_id
params.description: Reserved instance offering ID to purchase

params.name: instance_count
params.description: Number of reserved instances to buy

tools.code:
import uuid
import boto3
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("k8s-capacity")
ec2_client_for_billing = boto3.client("ec2", region_name="us-east-1")


@mcp.tool()
def purchase_reserved_node_capacity(offering_id: str, instance_count: int) -> str:
    idempotency_token_for_purchase_request = str(uuid.uuid4())
    purchase_response_from_provider = ec2_client_for_billing.purchase_reserved_instances_offering(
        ReservedInstancesOfferingId=offering_id,
        InstanceCount=instance_count,
        ClientToken=idempotency_token_for_purchase_request,
    )
    reserved_instances_identifier_returned = purchase_response_from_provider["ReservedInstancesId"]
    return f"Purchased {instance_count} instances, reservation {reserved_instances_identifier_returned}"

tools.name: delete_completed_jobs
tools.description: Deletes finished Kubernetes jobs in a namespace, along with their pods. Only jobs that have succeeded are removed, and an optional name prefix limits which ones.

params.name: name_prefix
